nodes.label: mpv_main()
nodes.desc: Entry point: creates MPContext, initializes, calls mp_play_files

nodes.label: struct MPContext
nodes.desc: One giant struct: tracks, statuses, timing, dispatch, options

nodes.label: mp_play_files()
nodes.desc: For(;;) over the playlist: idle_loop then play_current_file

nodes.label: idle_loop()
nodes.desc: STOP state loop: mp_idle() while waiting for a file or script

nodes.label: play_current_file()
nodes.desc: Opens demuxer, waits for it, then spins run_playloop

nodes.label: run_playloop()
nodes.desc: The heart: ~30 handler calls, then mp_wait_events()

nodes.label: mp_wait_events()
nodes.desc: mp_dispatch_queue_process() with the computed sleeptime

nodes.label: mp_set_timeout()
nodes.desc: Shrinks the sleep deadline, e.g. 0.1s for cache updates

nodes.label: mp_wakeup_core()
nodes.desc: mp_dispatch_interrupt() from any thread wakes the core

nodes.label: mp_process_input()
nodes.desc: Drains the command queue; run_command() per command

nodes.label: run_command()
nodes.desc: Executes pause, seek, volume, property writes and more

nodes.label: set_pause_state()
nodes.desc: Propagates pause to AO and VO, ignores elapsed pause time

nodes.label: execute_queued_seek()
nodes.desc: Runs at most one queued seek per iteration

nodes.label: handle_playback_restart()
nodes.desc: Flips READY to PLAYING once both chains are filled; starts AO

nodes.label: handle_eof()
nodes.desc: Sets AT_END_OF_FILE only when both chains drained and not paused

nodes.label: demux_thread()
nodes.desc: Loop: thread_work() or timedwait until next_cache_update

nodes.label: thread_work()
nodes.desc: One unit of demuxer work: read, seek, trackswitch, cache

nodes.label: read_packet()
nodes.desc: Reads one packet from the underlying demuxer implementation

nodes.label: prune_old_packets()
nodes.desc: Drops packets behind the reader unless caching keeps them

nodes.label: update_cache()
nodes.desc: Maintains cached byte ranges for seeks; schedules next update

nodes.label: demux_read_packet_async()
nodes.desc: Decoder-side pull; returns WAIT if the thread is still filling

nodes.label: demux_get_reader_state()
nodes.desc: Snapshot for the core: eof, idle, buffering percentages

nodes.label: write_video()
nodes.desc: Gate: VD_WAIT/VF_EOF from video_output_image(), then queue frame

nodes.label: video_output_image()
nodes.desc: Decode one image through the filter chain

nodes.label: check_framedrop()
nodes.desc: Sets drop count from last_av_difference / frame_time (clamped 0..100)

nodes.label: adjust_sync()
nodes.desc: Nudges mpctx->delay toward the audio timeline (max correction per frame)

nodes.label: vo_thread()
nodes.desc: Dispatch loop: render_frame(), vsync waits, pause/reset controls

nodes.label: render_frame()
nodes.desc: Marks frames late past their end time as dropped, then draws

nodes.label: vo_queue_frame()
nodes.desc: Hands a finished frame plus timing to the VO thread

nodes.label: fill_audio_out_buffers()
nodes.desc: SYNCING to READY when the AO queue is full; logs underruns

nodes.label: reinit_audio_chain()
nodes.desc: Rebuilds decoder, filters and AO for the selected audio track

nodes.label: audio_start_ao()
nodes.desc: Starts device playback once status is READY

nodes.label: ao_init_best()
nodes.desc: Probes driver list, opens the winning AO (or falls back)
